source.name: Item file choir-of-one
source.note: Derived: the time to empty counts from the first shot (Aegis Sustained)

fireRateRpm.note: Quantum's rate is per ammo (time to empty without the reloads, over the intervals of ADR 0013); a projectile takes the 5 ammo of Clarity

magazine.note: ammo of the magazine to projectiles, 5 ammo each (Clarity)

totalShots.note: ammo of the row to projectiles, 5 ammo each (Clarity)

reloadTimeMs.note: the simulator waits one projectile interval (5 ammo) before the reload; Quantum's reload leaves one ammo interval, so four more are taken off

catalyst.name: Refit
catalyst.description: One of three Refits to choose: Subsistence (Weapon Kills refill the magazine from reserves), Destabilizing Rounds (Weapon Kills apply Volatile around the target and grant Volatile Rounds), Onslaught (Weapon Kills grant stacks of Onslaught). All need Weapon Kills; against a boss without adds there is no effect.

damage.note: one hitscan round per ammo; a shot of the item is the 5 ammo of a projectile

notModelled.quote: Scoring kills in either mode triggers a 7.5 meter radius Void explosion, dealing 239 [?] damage and spawning a Radiolaria Pool at the target's location.
notModelled.reason: Kills: the boss is not killed within the fight (ADR 0015)

notModelled.quote: Pool deals 123 [?] Arc damage in a 3 meter radius once per second for 5 seconds.
meter radius, despawn after 100 meters, and cannot deal precision damage.
notModelled.reason: one boss, centre hit; the split projectiles take the Quantum row, which holds no precision

notModelled.quote: Hitting an enemy with the projectile before it splits deals 947 [233] damage in a 3 meter radius.
notModelled.reason: source conflict: Quantum's row after splitting is 570 per projectile; point-blank play is not the optimal hold (known-inaccuracies, W4 Choir of One)

notModelled.quote: Split projectiles individually deal 187 [49] damage each, totalling for 985 [245] damage in a 3 meter radius.
notModelled.reason: source conflict: Quantum's 570 per projectile instead of Clarity's 985 for all five splits hitting (known-inaccuracies, W4 Choir of One)

notModelled.quote: Projectile deals 243 [40.25] bodyshot damage and 435 [72] precision damage.
notModelled.reason: source conflict: Quantum's ADS row holds 146 body and 262 precision per round (known-inaccuracies, W4 Choir of One)

notModelled.quote: Weapon Kills refill 10% of the magazine (rounded up) from reserves.
Submachine Gun and Auto Rifle Kills refill 17% of the magazine.
Weapon Kills apply Volatile to enemies in a 7 meter radius around the target and grant Volatile Rounds for 3 seconds.
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Onslaught' for 4.5 seconds.

value.note: as the base rate, from the ADS row: one round per ammo, so five rounds per shot; the slower ADS rate is inside the time to empty
